svg.title: Brain-Book
svg.desc: Brain-Book (Reboot01 · peer-audited). A social platform where people post, join groups, share photos and message each other instantly. React, Go and a REST API. WebSockets for live delivery. Defended in a live audit. Built with Go, React, WebSockets, SQLite.
